statusDetail: Raw-CDP navigation was attempted at desktop and mobile viewports, including a 15-second wait, but Cloudflare returned a persistent human-verification challenge instead of the origin page. The authored site, its routes, and its primary flow could not be inspected.

page.notes: The only rendered surface was a Cloudflare managed challenge. Site archetypes and routes could not be discovered. Not covered: all origin templates, forms, account/commercial flows, interactions, and failure states.
